typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Trade Id} as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD OP_ISDA_ProductType} as string,
		{CounterParty Full Name} as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD LEI_CP} as string,
		Trader as string,
		{Sales Person} as string,
		Book as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD OP_ClearingEligibility} as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD EndUser_Clearing_Exception_Election} as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD OP_CLRELG_CME DESC} as string,
		{TRADE_KEYWORD OP_CLRELG_LCHUK DESC} as string,
		TradeStatus as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource1
FlatFileSource1 derive(FileName = toString(($FileName)),
		FileDate = toString((substring(toString($FileName), toInteger(42), toInteger(10))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileName} = FileName,
		{Copy of FileDate} = toDate(FileDate, "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion1
DataConversion1 derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 sink(input(
		LoadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRADE_KEYWORD_LEI_CP as string,
		Trader as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_ClearingEligibility as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_CLRELG_LCHUK_DESC as string,
		FileName as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_ISDA_ProductType as string,
		Trade_Id as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_EndUser_Clearing_Exception_Election as string,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_CLRELG_CME_DESC as string,
		CounterParty_Full_Name as string,
		FileDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Sales_Person as string,
		Book as string,
		Product_Type as string,
		TradeStatus as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_LEI_CP = {TRADE_KEYWORD LEI_CP},
		Trader,
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_ClearingEligibility = {TRADE_KEYWORD OP_ClearingEligibility},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_CLRELG_LCHUK_DESC = {TRADE_KEYWORD OP_CLRELG_LCHUK DESC},
		FileName = {Copy of FileName},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_ISDA_ProductType = {TRADE_KEYWORD OP_ISDA_ProductType},
		Trade_Id = {Trade Id},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_EndUser_Clearing_Exception_Election = {TRADE_KEYWORD EndUser_Clearing_Exception_Election},
		TRADE_KEYWORD_OP_CLRELG_CME_DESC = {TRADE_KEYWORD OP_CLRELG_CME DESC},
		CounterParty_Full_Name = {CounterParty Full Name},
		FileDate = {Copy of FileDate},
		Sales_Person = {Sales Person},
		Book,
		Product_Type = {Product Type},
		TradeStatus),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
